change_log.change: Synthesized control-plane architecture and governed agentic platform ownership into the role thesis.
Included distributed infrastructure as part of the enterprise platform arc.
Included enterprise adoption and commercial uptake as outcomes of the platform mandate.
Included productization, IP-led services, and commercial operating design.
Included lifecycle discipline connecting tailored work to repeatable deployment.
Included governance and operational discipline supporting regulated enterprise use.

claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned Unify Consulting’s mandate to make agentic AI a repeatable enterprise capability, uniting control-plane architecture, lifecycle discipline, distributed infrastructure and commercial operating design so regulated clients could move from tailored engagements toward durable, IP-led platform services and partner-enabled adoption.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows by setting control-plane architecture for deterministic routing and multi-agent orchestration.
- bul_unify_002: Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with commercialization and usage-based forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Strengthened production trust with audit-grade observability for regulated AI workflows through evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
- bul_unify_004: Accelerated the AI systems lifecycle from six months to three weeks by standardizing managed workflow orchestration from intake through production monitoring.
- bul_unify_005: Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS and Databricks Lakehouse data paths, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through a productized operating model.
